articles.title: Statistisches Bundesamt: Inflation sinkt im Dezember auf tiefsten Stand seit gut einem Jahr
articles.teaser: Im vergangenen Jahr sind die Verbraucherpreise im Schnitt um 2,2 Prozent gestiegen. Im Dezember schwächte sich die Inflationsrate aber deutlich ab – auf 1,8 Prozent.
articles.image_title: Statistisches Bundesamt: A woman picks items from a shelf of the refrigerated section at a store of the Penny supermarket chain in Berlin, Germany, on August 1, 2023. German inflation slowed in July 2023 after rising in June 2023, official data showed, but remained at high levels. The annual inflation rate in Europe's largest economy fell to 6.2 percent, down from 6.4 percent in June 2023, federal statistics office Destatis said on July 28, 2023 in preliminary figures. Consumer prices in Germany were no longer rising as quickly as they did at the end of 2022 after Russia's invasion of Ukraine sent the costs of energy and food soaring. articles.image_title: Stromausfall Berlin: BERLIN, GERMANY - JANUARY 4: A police line at the entrance to the closed Mexicoplaz S-Bahn train station, during power outage, following an arson attack on power cables on January 4, 2026 in Berlin, Germany. The attack on the cables happened at a bridge crossing the Teltow Canal caused a blackout affecting approximately 45,000 residents as well as local businesses, hospitals and nursing homes in southwestern Berlin. The Stromnetz Berlin utility company has since restored power to approximately 7,000 residents but others will likely have to wait much longer to be reconnected . According to police, the perpetrators set fire to the cables early Saturday morning, the incident is similar to a previous attack on the city's electricity infrastructure in 2025. (Photo by Omer Messinger/Getty Images)
